enterpriseGapAddressed: /teaching/[operation] detail pages no longer treat a persisted backend receipt as success when the receipt identifies a different operation or action slot than the clicked button.

proofSummary.regression: The teacher opens the knowledge-base operation page and clicks its primary action, but the backend returns a persisted course-settings:primary receipt and course-settings domain summary.
proofSummary.expectedBehavior: The page shows the receipt mismatch failure message and suppresses the mismatched course-settings saved-success message.

userVisibleFailureMessage.zh-CN: 服务端回执未匹配当前操作，请稍后重试。
userVisibleFailureMessage.en-US: The server receipt did not match the current operation. Please retry later.

redGreenEvidence.observedBeforeImplementation: failed as expected because the operation page did not render the receipt mismatch message for a persisted receipt that belonged to course-settings instead of knowledge-base

boundaries: This is local frontend detail-page error-closure hardening for the ordinary teaching operation pages.
It does not replace live production route smoke evidence for /teaching/[operation] or /api/teaching/operations.

The overall enterprise release gate remains blocked until owner-approved production app-auth, external-storage readiness, ordinary teaching route/browser smoke, and provider mutation proof are regenerated in one release run.
